Perfect! I've created a polished ecommerce home page with all the requested features. Here's what I built:

## ✅ Delivered

**Files created:**
- `index.html` - Main markup with all sections
- `styles.css` - Comprehensive dark styling
- `script.js` - Interactive functionality

**Features:**

🏠 **Hero Section** - Eye-catching welcome with call-to-action

⭐ **Featured Products** (4 items)
- Product cards with images, descriptions, ratings
- Wishlist toggle functionality
- "Add to Cart" buttons with cart updates

💰 **Deals Section** (4 deals)
- Dynamic countdown timer
- Discount badges
- Featured deal prominently displayed

📰 **Editorial Content** (3 articles)
- Fashion guides, trend reports, designer profiles
- Article dates and read-more links
- Professional card layout

🛒 **Shopping Cart**
- Modal popup with add/remove functionality
- Real-time price calculations
- Free shipping threshold ($200+)
- Cart counter badge

**Design Highlights:**
- Dark luxury aesthetic (gold & silver accents)
- Smooth hover animations and transitions
- Sticky navigation with smooth scrolling
- Responsive grid layouts
- Notification system for user feedback
- Modal cart management
- Professional typography and spacing

The page is fully functional with vanilla JavaScript—no frameworks required. Open `index.html` in a browser to see it in action!
